# Harshit Gulati

Harshit Gulati is a Software Engineer focused on building performant, user-centric web and desktop applications. His work spans modern frontend engineering, real-time systems, and medical-grade software, with experience delivering products using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Qt/QML, and C++.

## Details

* Role: Software Engineer
* Education: B.Tech in Aerospace Engineering with a Minor in Computer Science, PEC Chandigarh (CGPA: 8.41/10)
* Core Technologies: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, C++, Qt6, QML, WebSockets, Node.js
* Primary Focus: Software engineering, frontend architecture, desktop application development, performance optimization, and user experience

## Experience

### RNT Health Insights (Nov 2025 - Present)

Software Engineer working on medical-grade healthcare software and web platforms.

Key responsibilities include:

* Modernizing legacy medical endoscopy software from Qt Widgets to Qt Quick/QML
* Developing high-performance desktop interfaces using C++, Qt6, and QML
* Integrating complex business logic with modern user interfaces
* Building and maintaining web applications using Next.js and TypeScript
* Contributing to software architecture, performance improvements, and user experience initiatives

### Asezment Technologies (Jan 2025 - Jun 2025)

Software Engineering Intern

Key contributions:

* Built the frontend MVP for an AI-powered assessment platform
* Implemented browser-native camera, microphone, and screen-sharing proctoring systems
* Established a Turborepo monorepo architecture
* Developed reusable UI components and shared design systems
